scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。 本期覆盖提醒：来源多样性缺口：arXiv 9/10（90%），超过 70%；去重后仅有 1 篇适合本轨的网页补充，未用无关 HF/博客凑数。未入选中文原始文章。

papers.title: WeFair: Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in Short-Video Search
papers.authors: Yingtao Ren, Aolin Li, Cheng Cheng, Huiyun Hu, Huasheng Liang, Baoxing Xie, Jun Yuan, Haijun Wu, Chenxing Wang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.16927v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Short-video search requires compact query rewriters that infer personalized intent from brief, ambiguous queries under strict latency constraints. The challenge is to decide when personalization is warranted and generate a reformulation that preserves the user's immediate information need. A rewriter optimized for fluency or engagement may still introduce unsupported details and redirect the search toward a different intent. Existing methods often underutilize users' actual reformulations and behavioral traces, relying instead on synthetic reasoning and indirect behavioral rewards that may produce more engaging candidates but cause intent drift. To build an effective rewriter that remains faithful to user intent, we propose WeFair, Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in WeChat short-video search. WeFair assigns real user behavioral signals to a progression from demonstration to preference to veri
papers.summary: WeFair 面向短视频搜索的个性化查询改写，按监督学习、消费偏好对齐和真实改写验证逐步训练模型，限制用户行为奖励带来的意图漂移。微信线上实验显示，有效点击查询率相对增加 1.576%，查询重写率相对下降 1.731%；这些是相对变化，不能解释为百分点。
papers.key_insight: 社区短文本搜索也容易把个性化扩展误当成用户当前需求，可借鉴其真实会话改写挖掘、DPO 偏好对齐和严格验证奖励。建议同时观察有效消费、重复改写及意图保持，先建立可靠的行为反馈口径，再判断强化学习是否值得投入，不能只优化点击。

papers.title: Data Curation and Model Souping: Unlocking Qwen3-0.6B for MS MARCO Passage Ranking
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.14816v2 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This report studies passage retrieval and re-ranking on the MS MARCO benchmark using lightweight Qwen3-0.6B models. Across three experimental settings --- BM25-then-reranking task, corpus-wide dense retrieval task, and dense retrieval then re-ranking task --- the results demonstrate that competitive ranking performance can be achieved without complex architectural modifications, custom loss functions, or cross-encoder distillation. Instead, substantial gains stem from data-centric strategies: corpus-targeted continued pre-training, rigorous data curation, hard-negative mining, training--inference distribution alignment, and weight merging via Model Soup. In particular, Model Soup delivers marked performance gains while preserving the inference efficiency of a single model. These findings highlight how data curation and weight merging can push sub-billion-parameter models to state-of-the-art performance. My models can be downloaded from H
papers.summary: 论文研究 Qwen3-0.6B 在 MS MARCO 的召回与重排，重点采用语料预训练、难负例、训练推理对齐和模型权重合并。初始重排模型 MRR@10 为 0.3289，仅使用 10 万查询微调即可达到 0.3817；作者还发现标题拼接会影响基准可比性，因此复现了公开检查点。
papers.key_insight: 对于社区帖子重排，应先检查标题、正文和负例构造是否一致，再增加模型规模。权重合并可维持单模型推理成本，但需单独验证不同检查点是否兼容；这里的离线增益来自 MS MARCO，迁移到中文 UGC 后仍要按长尾词、口语表达和时间敏感查询分桶测试。

papers.title: From a Large-Scale Teacher to Efficient Multimodal Students for Search Relevance Prediction
papers.authors: Tomasz Gniazdowski, Mohammadreza Momenifar, Nadia Vase, Shahram Khadivi, Wiktor Walentynowicz, Nicola Ueffing, Jan Pawlowski, Piotr Szymanski, Abraham Bagherjeiran
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.16569v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Relevance prediction between user queries and items is a fundamental component of e-commerce search systems. Traditionally, high-quality relevance labels are obtained through human judgment, which is reliable but expensive, slow, and difficult to scale. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable automated relevance judgment at scale, achieving performance comparable to human annotators. However, such systems often rely on large commercial LLMs with complex prompts, resulting in high inference costs and limited throughput.
  In this work, we propose a framework that bridges this gap by distilling a high-performing LLM-based relevance judgment system into efficient multimodal student models. We first curate a small, high-quality human-annotated dataset to serve as ground truth. Using this dataset, we develop a reliable LLM-as-a-judge pipeline through careful prompt engineering and iterative refinement. This pipeline is then use
papers.summary: eBay 团队把查询与商品相关性判定拆成小规模人工校准、教师批量标注和轻量多模态学生蒸馏。GPT-4.1 教师在人标基准上的多分类准确率约为 83.7%，再用其标签与解释训练学生；正文比较了多种学生及效率权衡，不能据此假定线上搜索 CTR 已获得提升。
papers.key_insight: 社区帖子包含图片和短正文，可借鉴先用少量人工样本验证教师，再扩展标注的流程。教师一致性和标签口径比直接批量生成更重要，建议保留独立人标集，分别审查图文冲突与标题误导样本；相关性分类准确率也需要进一步连接到 nDCG 和真实点击体验。

papers.title: Simple Linear Corrections for Compression in Late Interaction
papers.authors: Mihir Agarwal, Sabyasachi Basu, Viraj Agrawal
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.14196v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Late-interaction (multi-vector) models represent documents using a set of token-level vectors, providing a middle ground between cross-encoders and dense encoders in terms of quality and cost of embedding. However, compared to the latter, the indices are costly to store and score. Pooling and pruning based compression techniques are deployed widely but deteriorate in quality noticeably with aggressive compression. We investigate whether a lightweight change to the scoring function can recover retrieval quality after document-vector compression. For each combination of encoder, compressor, and vector budget, we learn a global linear correction by distilling the uncompressed model's score distributions over candidate documents. The encoder and compressor remain frozen, and the correction can be applied to each query at search time or once, offline, to the stored vectors.
  We evaluate the method with ColBERTv2 and Jina v4 on MS MARCO and B
papers.summary: 该文在冻结编码器和压缩器的情况下，蒸馏未压缩模型的评分分布，学习全局线性校正，以恢复多向量压缩后的检索质量。在 BEIR 域内实验的 160 种设置中，154 种优于原压缩基线；MS MARCO 上压到每文档 4 个向量时，ColBERTv2 的相对召回增益最高约 22%。
papers.key_insight: 多向量召回用于社区短文本时，可先量化压缩引起的相关性损失，再用小型线性映射修复评分几何。该方法避免重训编码器，但跨域迁移并非稳定有效，尤其不能把域内的 154/160 直接当成线上成功率；应在自有查询和固定存储预算下比较召回质量。

papers.title: Faithful Query Resolution for Conversational Search
papers.authors: Saber Zerhoudi, Ivica Kostric, Jelena Mitrovic
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.15034v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Conversational query rewriting makes context-dependent requests explicit for retrieval, but additional context can introduce an information need the user did not express. This raises a question about the interaction between query fidelity and retrieval breadth. This paper examines that interaction in behavior-adaptive conversational search, using iKAT SCAI 2026 as the evaluation setting. We compare five query-generation configurations within a behavior-adaptive assistant using BM25 and SPLADE retrieval. A minimal-faithful resolver preserves the user's wording and resolves only context-dependent references; weighted reciprocal rank fusion combines its rankings with those from a learned rewriter and the raw utterance. Offline evaluation shows that adding these formulations recovers recall over the faithful query alone, with a slight reduction in nDCG@10. Across our five iKAT SCAI 2026 submissions, the weighted configuration obtains the hig
papers.summary: 论文对比五种会话查询生成配置，忠实解析只补齐指代，再将其与学习型改写和原始话语做加权排名融合。离线融合将 Recall@1000 从 0.448 提高到 0.519，nDCG@10 却从 0.231 降到 0.228；官方提交的 nDCG@5 为 0.534，比最强替代配置高 5.3%。
papers.key_insight: 社区会话搜索可保留原查询和最小改写作为独立召回通道，并通过融合权重控制扩展强度。此结果提醒我们召回提升与首屏质量、对话满意度可能分离，应分别评价指代消解是否正确、扩展是否引入未表达的需求，以及额外召回能否在重排阶段留下真正相关内容。

papers.title: CoverSynth: Coverage-Guided Generation of Retrieval Evaluation Sets
papers.authors: Anahita Sharma, Apaar Shanker, Rishav Chakravarti, Sneha Srinivasan, Vijay Kalmath, Dylan Wilbur, Yuan Li, Sara Bolouki, Yuan Xue
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.15409v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Enterprise agents need retrieval evaluation sets that expose domain-specific failures and guide developers towards efficient deployment tradeoffs. Neither expert-human-authored sets nor current synthetic generation methods provide a methodology for achieving the necessary coverage, reliability, efficiency, and discriminability required for such decision-making. Simultaneously, the field does not have an assessment framework for determining when an evaluation set has satisfied these properties. We introduce an evaluation set assessment framework for these criteria and CoverSynth -- a generator specifically designed to satisfy these criteria without incurring the high cost of human expert labeling. Starting from an unannotated corpus, CoverSynth targets coverage across retrieval demands and system capabilities. Deterministic checks locate evidence quotes in their sources, while model-based checks assess semantic validity to guarantee relia
papers.summary: CoverSynth 从语料依赖结构出发生成具有覆盖目标和可定位证据的检索评测集，并加入无法回答与含糊请求。RepLiQA 上，人类查询中 91% 能被 12 个被测系统全部回答，生成查询仅为 12%；重复实验里，生成集识别出 12/12 个模型对比，人类集为 4/12，显示更强区分能力。
papers.key_insight: 社区检索评测可以先覆盖主题、证据跨度、查询歧义和无答案情形，再追求数据量。生成问题需要可回溯的原文证据与独立语义校验，避免合成集只制造难题却偏离真实流量；建议与线上采样的人标集合并观察，而不是用更难的合成集合替换全部业务评价。

papers.title: Self-improving data synthesis can scale embedding models across domains and tasks
papers.authors: Zucan Lyu, Rui Tang, Jianlyu Chen, Peisheng Jin, Zheng Liu, Defu Lian
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.14730v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Adapting embedding models to new tasks requires training data that reflect task-specific information needs and relevance criteria. However, manual data design is costly and difficult to scale. Here we introduce SYNTRA, a novel retrieval data synthesis method whose self-improvement loop iteratively refines reusable synthesis instructions using feedback on trial outputs. This process requires only an unlabelled corpus and a few relevant query-document pairs. Experiments across 24 retrieval datasets spanning 15 domains demonstrate the effectiveness of the synthesized data. These data also improve widely used, strong embedding models on tasks with and without existing labelled training sets. Self-improvement enhances retrieval on all six evaluated tasks, outperforming human calibration on four. Moreover, retrieval performance continues to improve on MS MARCO as we scale the training dataset to 32 times its initial size. Overall, with minimal
papers.summary: SYNTRA 通过任务定义迭代、标识与属性构建、查询生成和相关性标注，把未标注语料转成嵌入训练数据。作者用 Qwen3-30B-A3B 生成数据并以 Qwen3-0.6B 做任务适配；人工核验覆盖 150 对查询文档、7 位标注者，报告二分类一致率的 95% 区间为 86.7%–95.3%。
papers.key_insight: 当社区搜索缺乏长尾相关性样本时，可以复用其任务级生成与自校准流程，但应优先验证伪标签可靠性。需要把生成、训练与评测语料分开，并与相同训练预算的人类查询基线比较；论文的生成阶段使用多张 GPU，采用前还应核算每条有效样本的实际成本。

papers.title: RALI@iKAT 2026: Retrieval-aware User Profile Denoising via Personalized Conversational Dense Retrieval
papers.authors: Yuchen Hui, Fengran Mo, Jia Ao Sun, Yuxing Tian, Wenhao Xu, Jian-Yun Nie
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.17673v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Modern conversational information access systems continuously extract user information from conversations to build user profiles for personalized retrieval. As user profiles accumulate over time, they inevitably become noisy, making effective user profile denoising a fundamental challenge. Existing personalized conversational query reformulation methods rely on the black-box reasoning capability of LLMs to expand the original query with relevant user profile phrases, producing a verbose query for retrieval. Such rewrite-then-retrieve pipelines reduce user profile denoising to the explicit selection of profile phrases in the sparse token space, separating personalization from downstream relevance modeling. Consequently, they often fail to identify user information that is truly beneficial for retrieval.
  To enable retrieval-aware user profile denoising, we propose Personalized Conversational Dense Retrieval (PCDR), which learns to jointl
papers.summary: PCDR 针对会话用户画像随时间积累噪声的问题，把画像去噪交给下游稠密检索训练，而非先独立挑选画像短语。通过查询重写蒸馏、分级相关性训练和全局负例等设计，在 1.16 亿段落索引上评估，完整画像配置的留出集 nDCG@3 从 29.0 提升至 33.1。
papers.key_insight: 对社区搜索而言，用户长期兴趣应该作为有约束的辅助信号，不能覆盖当前查询。可先比较完整画像、过滤画像和无画像三个版本，再检查召回训练是否真正抑制无关兴趣；论文留出评估仅 44 轮，收益幅度仍需更大规模的独立验证，尤其要避免浅候选池调参误导。

papers.title: Graph-free Retrieval with Graph-Modified Embeddings
papers.authors: Federica Santi (Cognee Inc), Vasilije Markovi\'{c} (Cognee Inc), Daniel Scott (Cognee Inc), Lazar Obradovi\'{c} (Cognee Inc)
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.18410v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Dense vector retrieval can miss evidence connected through intermediate entities, while direct graph retrieval requires access to the graph at query time. We compare five offline graph-based embedding transformations and strategies for using the resulting graph-modified embeddings alongside the originals, without query-time graph access. On a synthetic professional-network benchmark with complete supporting-evidence sets, direct replacement of the original embeddings reduces evidence recovery. Multi-stage strategies improve recovery by using graph-modified embeddings to guide the search while retaining the originals for semantic relevance. On questions requiring linked facts or comparisons among candidates, the strongest configuration improves recovery by up to 25.9% relative to plain vector retrieval. It also matches baseline recovery with 40% fewer returned nodes. Controls confirm that graph information contributes beyond multi-stage r
papers.summary: 研究比较五种离线图结构嵌入变换，并在在线阶段保留原向量语义、用变换向量引导多阶段召回。合成职业关系基准上，最佳配置对复杂关联问题的证据恢复相对增益最高为 25.9%，同时可用少 40% 的返回节点匹配原召回水平；直接替换原向量反而降低恢复率。
papers.key_insight: 如果社区内容已有实体或话题关系，可尝试离线吸收结构信号，再以原始语义向量承担相关性约束。该工作更支持双通道或分阶段召回，而不是把图变换后向量无条件写回主索引；由于证据来自合成关系数据，需先在真实帖子关联和噪声实体上验证收益是否保留。

papers.title: On Reranking Space for Multi-Tenant Retrieval with Adapted Queries
papers.abstract: 23 LoRA-adapted tenant pairs, four adapter architectures, four index configurations. Source-space reranking improves nDCG@10 over target-space by more than 10 percentage points in some cases; blending helps coarse indexes.
papers.summary: 该文比较多租户共享压缩索引中，查询经过适配后应在哪个空间重排。覆盖 23 组 LoRA 租户数据、4 种适配器和 4 类索引，原索引空间重排更稳定，部分设置的 nDCG@10 优势超过 10 个百分点；粗量化索引上还可混合两个空间的距离，补充不同信号。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索若按垂类微调查询编码器却共享文档索引，可先验证重排距离所在空间。优先保留共享索引，并在原空间建立简单基线；该结论针对嵌入适配和压缩组合，不能直接推广到所有多租户系统，是否混合距离还需结合延迟预算与适配器质量确定。
